name: Mannami Yoshio
source:
Japanese History Teacher at Mizusumino Academy

He and Taizo were classmates back in their student days, and they’ve been friends ever since.
Even back then, Taizo treated him like a subordinate, and that dynamic hasn’t changed to this day.
